```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

jobs:
  create-release:
    name: Create Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}
      tag_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get version from Cargo.toml
        id: get_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep '^version =' Cargo.toml | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/version = "([^"]+)"/\1/')
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate tag version
        id: get_tag
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          if [[ "$TAG_NAME" != "v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}" ]]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG_NAME does not match Cargo.toml version ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "tag_name=$TAG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Draft Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}
          release_name: "Release ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}"
          body: "Precompiled binaries for ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.tag_name }}"
          draft: true

  build-linux-x86_64:
    name: Build Linux x86_64 (${{ matrix.cuda }})
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        cuda: ["cpu", "11.8", "12.4", "13.0"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lld pkg-config libssl-dev

      - name: Setup CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda != 'cpu'
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.14
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          method: network

      - name: Build CLI
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cuda }}" == "cpu" ]; then
            cargo build --release --bin cake --no-default-features
          else
            cargo build --release --bin cake --features cuda
          fi

      - name: Package Artifact
        run: |
          ARTIFACT_NAME="cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda }}"
          mkdir -p $ARTIFACT_NAME
          cp target/release/cake $ARTIFACT_NAME/
          tar -czf $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz $ARTIFACT_NAME
          sha256sum $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz > $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda }}.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda }}.tar.gz
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

      - name: Upload Checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda }}.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda }}.tar.gz.sha256
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

  build-linux-aarch64:
    name: Build Linux aarch64 (CPU)
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install cross
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/cross-rs/cross/releases/download/v0.2.5/cross-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv cross /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Build CLI
        run: |
          cross build --release --bin cake --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-default-features

      - name: Package Artifact
        run: |
          ARTIFACT_NAME="cake-linux-aarch64-cpu"
          mkdir -p $ARTIFACT_NAME
          cp target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/cake $ARTIFACT_NAME/
          tar -czf $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz $ARTIFACT_NAME
          sha256sum $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz > $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-linux-aarch64-cpu.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-linux-aarch64-cpu.tar.gz
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

      - name: Upload Checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-linux-aarch64-cpu.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-linux-aarch64-cpu.tar.gz.sha256
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

  build-macos-arm64:
    name: Build macOS arm64 (Metal)
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build CLI
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin cake --features metal

      - name: Package Artifact
        run: |
          ARTIFACT_NAME="cake-macos-arm64-metal"
          mkdir -p $ARTIFACT_NAME
          cp target/release/cake $ARTIFACT_NAME/
          tar -czf $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz $ARTIFACT_NAME
          shasum -a 256 $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz > $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-macos-arm64-metal.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-macos-arm64-metal.tar.gz
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

      - name: Upload Checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-macos-arm64-metal.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-macos-arm64-metal.tar.gz.sha256
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

  build-android-aarch64:
    name: Build Android aarch64 (CPU)
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install cross
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/cross-rs/cross/releases/download/v0.2.5/cross-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv cross /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Build Mobile Library
        run: |
          cross build --release --lib --target aarch64-linux-android --package cake-mobile

      - name: Package Artifact
        run: |
          ARTIFACT_NAME="cake-mobile-android-aarch64"
          mkdir -p $ARTIFACT_NAME
          cp target/aarch64-linux-android/release/libcake_mobile.so $ARTIFACT_NAME/
          tar -czf $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz $ARTIFACT_NAME
          sha256sum $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz > $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

      - name: Upload Checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

  build-ios-arm64:
    name: Build iOS arm64 (Metal)
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Mobile Library
        run: |
          cargo build --release --lib --target aarch64-apple-ios --package cake-mobile --features metal

      - name: Package Artifact
        run: |
          ARTIFACT_NAME="cake-mobile-ios-arm64"
          mkdir -p $ARTIFACT_NAME
          cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcake_mobile.a $ARTIFACT_NAME/
          tar -czf $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz $ARTIFACT_NAME
          shasum -a 256 $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz > $ARTIFACT_NAME.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz
          overwrite: true
          draft: true

      - name: Upload Checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: cake-mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag_name }}
          asset_name: cake-mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          overwrite: true
          draft: true
```
